findings.element: How we get the data > 'Set import methods' link on the Automatic file retrieval card (Stripe + clearing)
findings.finding: Opening the import-method details also changes the setup: the Integration side switches from automatic to Assisted, which adds two required file uploads the user never asked for.
findings.user_impact: A user who opens it only to check the methods, then clicks Run, gets 'Upload the required file' for a reconciliation that was fully automatic a moment earlier.
findings.suggested_fix: When the panel expands from the automatic card, keep both sides on Automated and add upload fields only if the user picks Assisted or Manual.

evidence.action: Stripe + 'Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder)': the auto card showed 'Synder pulls QuickBooks and Stripe'. Clicked 'Set import methods', then Run with one file missing.
evidence.observed: The Integration Import method became 'Assisted' ('value after toggle: Assisted') with two 'Upload file *' zones (Balance change from activity, Payouts). Run was blocked with 'Upload the required file'.

findings.element: How we get the data > Integration panel > 'How to get this file' accordion (Stripe, Manual method)
findings.finding: When Stripe is on Manual, the upload zone never says which Stripe report to export; it only says 'How to get this file'. Assisted mode names the reports ('Balance change from the activity', 'Payouts').
findings.user_impact: Users who picked a non-clearing account are forced into Manual and can't tell which export to produce, so they stall or upload the wrong file right where the funnel already loses most users.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the exact Stripe report in the Manual upload label and accordion title, the same way the Assisted and QuickBooks labels do.

evidence.action: Selected Integration = mzkt.by (Stripe), then Account = Stripe fees (and separately Business Checking); also switched the Integration Import method to Manual on the clearing account.
evidence.observed: The Integration side showed 'Import method * Manual / Upload file * / How to get this file / Browse or drag your file here'. The Accounting side named its file: 'How to get General ledger export from QuickBooks Online'.

findings.element: Account to reconcile > 'Synder accounts (manual file upload required)' group, and the Accounting-side Import method
findings.finding: Accounts under the same 'manual file upload required' heading behave differently. For Stripe, the Accounting side is locked to Manual with a QuickBooks upload. For PayPal and Shopify, the Accounting side stays on 'Automated (recommended)' with no upload.
findings.user_impact: Users can't predict which files an account will need from its group label, and a Stripe user shown a one-option 'Manual' dropdown has no way to see why QuickBooks retrieval is suddenly unavailable.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the group label match what actually happens for every integration, and when a side is locked to Manual, replace the one-option select with a short line that says why.

evidence.action: Picked Stripe + Stripe fees, then PayPal + PayPal clearing, then Shopify + Shopify clearing (Synder). All three accounts sit in the 'manual file upload required' group.
evidence.observed: Stripe fees: Accounting 'Import method * Manual' (only option) plus 'Upload file * ... General ledger export from QuickBooks Online'. PayPal and Shopify: Accounting 'Import method * Automated (recommended) / Manual' with no upload zone.

findings.element: Period > Custom start/end date inputs and Run reconciliation
findings.finding: Custom ranges entirely in the future, or ending today, are accepted and the run starts. The date inputs have no min or max, so nothing warns the user. By spec, today's date can't be selected.
findings.user_impact: Users can start a run that can't return meaningful results (a future period, or a partial today), and only find out later from an empty or incomplete reconciliation.
findings.suggested_fix: Cap the end date at yesterday and refuse future-only ranges with an inline message on the date field, the same way reversed ranges are already refused.

evidence.action: Custom period with Stripe + clearing, then Run: Nov 1–30, 2026, and separately Sep 1–25 (today).
evidence.observed: Nov 1–30: error '', started=true, hint '2026-11-01 – 2026-11-30'. Sep 1–25: error '', started=true. The date inputs had min='' and max=''.

findings.element: Run status > error banner for a missing upload (Assisted, two drop zones)
findings.finding: The missing-file error says only 'Upload the required file' when two uploads are required, and it moves focus to the Run button instead of the missing zone. The integration and account errors do point at their field.
findings.user_impact: On the step that needs the most effort, users have to work out for themselves which of the two uploads is missing, which adds friction right where users most often give up.
findings.suggested_fix: Name the missing report in the banner (for example 'Upload the Payouts file from Stripe'), mark that drop zone invalid, and move to it.

evidence.action: Stripe + clearing, Set import methods (Integration = Assisted, two Upload file * zones), uploaded one file, clicked Run reconciliation.
evidence.observed: The error read 'Upload the required file' and focus went to 'button#run Run reconciliation'. The empty-form case, by contrast, focused the Integration select and marked it invalid.

gaps: Retrieval failure and empty-result states are not implemented, so KF-9 precondition errors (missing mappings, multi-currency off, closed period, lost QBO authorization) can't be checked for whether they name the failed precondition and how to fix it
Overlap validation (same clearing account, overlapping period) was never exercised, so it's unknown whether a conflicting run is refused and how that's explained
Run with a missing QuickBooks upload (Stripe non-clearing account, Accounting side Manual) was not exercised, so that error's wording and focus are unknown
The steps in the 'How to get this file' accordion for Stripe Manual were not captured, so it's unknown whether the steps name the report even though the title doesn't
PayPal Assisted: it wasn't checked whether Run needs both the Activity download and the Settlement report, or only one
After 'Reconciliation started' there is no results screen and no exercised path to start another run or leave, so what happens next is untested
